title: Basic Publisher/Subscriber Examples in ROS 2 (rclpy)
description: The publish/subscribe communication pattern is fundamental to ROS 2, allowing nodes to asynchronously exchange messages. This chapter provides hands-on Python code examples using rclpy to demonstrate how to create a basic publisher and a basic subscriber.
